description: The bar chart illustrates self-report accuracy, measured as "Instilled Preferences," for two language models—GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini—across three conditions: Control, Before Introspection Training, and After Introspection Training. The vertical axis, labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)," ranges from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, and 1.00. The horizontal axis displays the two model types. For both models, the Control condition (gray bars) shows low accuracy, with GPT-4o at approximately 0.25 and GPT-4o-mini at approximately 0.00. The Before Introspection Training condition (light blue bars) shows a significant increase in accuracy for both models, with GPT-4o at approximately 0.60 and GPT-4o-mini at approximately 0.55. The After Introspection Training condition (dark purple bars) shows the highest accuracy, with GPT-4o at approximately 0.75 and GPT-4o-mini at approximately 0.75. Error bars are present for all bars, indicating variability in the measurements. The chart demonstrates that introspection training substantially improves self-report accuracy for both models, with the improvement being more pronounced for GPT-4o-mini, which starts from a lower baseline.
